raw_message.reasoning:
Now I understand the alignment handling. Looking at lines 1149-1154:
- Left alignment (`<`): `s = '%s%s*' % (s, fill)` - value followed by fill characters
- Right alignment (`>`): `s = '%s*%s' % (fill, s)` - fill characters followed by value  
- Center alignment (`^`): `s = '%s*%s%s*' % (fill, s, fill)` - fill, value, fill

The issue is that left and center aligned searches should consume input up to the next space character. Currently, the regex for left-aligned text would be something like `.{1,}? *` which means it matches the shortest possible string followed by zero or more spaces. But this doesn't properly handle the case where we want to stop at the next space.
